blockers.criterion: Frozen shapeVolume + materialDetail: soft worn timber construction with selected broken/plank structure
blockers.location: N/S native and published hull broad faces and cabin, also logical128cell and repeated/actor context
blockers.evidence: The body reads as three uniformly blue, clean horizontal strips with a nearly continuous flat top. The cabin is an unbroken smooth box under a broad clean roof. One shallow V notch and two pale rope wraps add a little character, but the main hull/cabin still read as pristine toy/plastic panels rather than worn wreck timber. This remains visible in both browser modes at logical128cell; phone reduction turns the body into a plain cyan slab.
blockers.effect: The candidate improves softness and end volume but still misses the chosen target's coarse crafted/weathered construction, a frozen visible outcome rather than a demand for exact target decoration.
blockers.desiredVisibleOutcome: Give the main hull and cabin a restrained, readable worn timber structure: broader purposeful irregularity or selected broken/plank boundaries and material separation that reads at logical128cell and leaves a wreck impression at phone32cell. Keep the blue background hierarchy, coherent assembly, softened forms and E/W improvement. Exact target cracks, barnacle/foliage counts, bright wood/gold, surface texture technique and part count remain optional editor choices.
